name: oracle-config-check
description: Oracle config check: reads the JSON price oracle configuration of a DeFi protocol before it is deployed (for each asset the network, the role, the Chainlink AggregatorV3 proxy or other feed with its heartbeat, deviation threshold and decimals, a fallback such as a TWAP, the staleness threshold, the price bounds, the decimals the protocol scales by, the L2 sequencer uptime check with its grace period and the checks made on each answer), contacts no chain or RPC, fetches nothing and runs nothing, and lists with file and line the problems that lead to bad liquidations or drained pools: staleness thresholds missing, longer than the heartbeat or not longer than it, bounds missing, inverted or rejecting a plausible price, decimals that do not match, rollups with no sequencer check or grace period, deprecated answeredInRound checks, malformed or shared feed addresses, collateral with a single source and stablecoins fixed at their peg. Text, markdown, JSON and SARIF output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
